# Finish Line Home Repair

> Realtor-trusted home repair and inspection punch-list services in Lafayette and West Lafayette, Indiana. One owner-operated contractor for the common repairs that keep real-estate closings on track.

## About
Finish Line Home Repair is owner-operated: when you call, you talk to the owner — not a call center. Over 20 years of maintenance and repair experience. Locally owned and fully insured.

## Service Area
Lafayette, West Lafayette, Dayton, Rossville, Brookston, Battle Ground, and surrounding Indiana communities.

## Services
- Inspection repair punch lists (the whole repair addendum as one project)
- Drywall repair and paint touch-ups
- Minor electrical repairs (outlets, switches, fixtures, GFCI, smoke detectors)
- Minor plumbing repairs (faucets, drains, shutoffs, toilets, disposals)
- Trim and finish carpentry
- Doors and hardware
- Window repairs
- Deck and exterior repairs
- Gutters and downspouts
- General handyman services

## For Realtors
"You close the deal. We clear the punch list." Deadline-aware scheduling around closing dates, one contact for the whole repair addendum, and clear itemized quotes both sides can read.
